abstract: Tier-1 individual-level synthetic sample for the Silicon Sample Benchmark (team_19). A single language model (Claude, via Claude Code) read the full survey instrument and all sixteen intervention texts and wrote an explicit generative model as a parameter file (control baselines per item, demographic structure, a per-intervention x per-outcome treatment-effect matrix, and partisan moderation); a seeded simulator then draws 4,000 synthetic profiles and runs each through all 17 conditions with common random numbers (68,000 rows; 4,000 per condition). No external API calls, no data from this study.
approach_family: per-respondent simulation from an LLM-elicited explicit generative model; single model; zero-shot (no fine-tuning, no retrieval)
